title: Website copy
description: Turn an approved offer into website structure and copy: headings, service scope, answers to questions and a clear next step.
input: Approved offer or service facts, website audience and the customer's real next step.
output: Draft website copy, a separate list of missing facts and points for owner review.

environments.name: Codex CLI
environments.limitations: 12 fictional runs per package: 3 business models × 4 cases. No model override was supplied; the CLI did not expose its model ID. Runs used an isolated, read-only workspace. Every run confirmed reading the complete SKILL.md, and responses were manually assessed against case criteria. Only Codex CLI was verified; other environments remain unverified. This evidence describes the original Polish package; the English translation has not been separately verified.

changelog.summary: Approved for the public catalogue. English translation of the same package; original approval metadata retained.
